text: 65-year-old female. The patient is here for an annual well-check. She has a history of well-controlled diabetes and hypertension, managed with metformin and losartan, respectively. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Diabetes-related skin condition (e.g., necrobiosis lipoidica or diabetic dermopathy).

Given your history of well-controlled diabetes and the location on your dorsal hand, this is consistent with common diabetic skin manifestations. Are you experiencing any pain, numbness, or open sores in the affected area, and have you noticed any recent changes in color or thickness?
